subject: Animation
title: Your Name Shatters Box Office Records
description: A short lesson to help you apply Your Name Shatters Box Office Records.

hook.text: In 2016, Makoto Shinkai released Your Name, a love story about two teenagers swapping bodies.

buildup.text: Nobody expected it to succeed at this scale. Shinkai was known for small, melancholic art films.

discovery.text: Your Name earned over $380 million worldwide, becoming the highest-grossing anime film at the time.

twist.text: The film proved anime could be a mainstream global theatrical event, not just a niche interest.

climax.text: Hollywood immediately tried to remake it. Studios finally realized anime had massive crossover appeal.

punchline.text: A teenage love story made the world fall for anime.

quiz.question: What did Your Name's success demonstrate?
options: That anime could only succeed in Japan
That anime could be a mainstream global theatrical event with massive crossover appeal
That only Studio Ghibli films could succeed internationally

details.summary: Your Name (2016) by Makoto Shinkai became the highest-grossing anime film at the time, earning over $380 million worldwide. Its body-swap romance, stunning visuals, and emotional resonance made it a global phenomenon beyond typical anime audiences.
details.whyItMatters: Your Name proved that anime films by directors other than Miyazaki could achieve massive global success. It launched Shinkai as anime's next great filmmaker and showed Hollywood that anime is a global box office force.
takeaways: Your Name earned over $380 million to become a global phenomenon
Makoto Shinkai emerged as anime's next major film auteur
The film reached mainstream audiences far beyond typical anime fans

faq.question: What made Your Name appeal beyond the typical anime audience?
faq.answer: Universal themes of connection, loss, and longing wrapped in a unique body-swap premise. Photorealistic backgrounds combined with expressive character animation created a visual stunning experience. The story was emotionally accessible without anime knowledge.

faq.question: How did Your Name change the anime film industry?
faq.answer: It proved non-Ghibli anime films could achieve massive international box office success. Western distributors began investing in anime theatrical releases. Makoto Shinkai's subsequent films received major international marketing and distribution.
